subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Steam Turbines: Spinning with Vapor
description: A quick, practical guide to Steam Turbines: Spinning with Vapor.

hook.text: Boil water, aim the steam at blades, and you have a power plant.

buildup.text: High-pressure steam expands through rows of blades, spinning the rotor.

discovery.text: Multiple stages extract energy step by step as steam drops in pressure.

twist.text: Modern steam turbines hit 45% efficiency — better than any piston engine.

climax.text: Most of the world's electricity comes from steam turbines in some form.

punchline.text: Steam still powers the modern world. The fuel just changed.

quiz.question: How do multi-stage steam turbines improve efficiency?
options: Each stage reheats the steam to add energy
Multiple blade rows extract energy step by step as steam expands
Later stages spin faster to capture remaining heat
